title: The parcel text
explanation: Three lines were warning signs: a rushing deadline, a gift card payment, and a demand for secrecy. The polite greeting and the tracking number looked fine, which is why a scam can feel real. Check what it wants, not how it sounds.
setup: This text just arrived from a number you do not know. Tap every line that is a warning sign. (This is a made-up practice message.)

sentences.text: Hello Amara, this is Sunbeam Parcels.
Your parcel is on hold and will be sent back in 2 hours.
sentences.note: A tight deadline is a pressure tactic. Scammers rush you so you cannot stop and think, or talk to someone you trust.

sentences.text: To release it, pay the $3 fee with a gift card and send us the code.
sentences.note: Real businesses and agencies do not ask for payment by gift card. Anyone who asks for the code is asking for your money.

sentences.text: Do not tell anyone about this message.
sentences.note: A message that asks you to keep a secret wants you alone. Show it to a trusted adult.

sentences.text: Thank you for choosing Sunbeam Parcels.
